🔒 Privacy Policy

HabitLoop - Your Personal Habit Tracking Companion

Last updated: September 20, 2025

1. Information We Collect

We collect only the minimum data required for authentication and personalized habit tracking:

  • Account Information: Name, email address, and password (encrypted)
  • Habit Data: Your habits, completion records, and progress statistics
  • Usage Data: App interactions to improve our service
  • Device Information: Basic device info for app optimization

2. How We Use Your Information

Your data is used exclusively to:

  • Provide personalized habit tracking and recommendations
  • Generate AI-powered insights and analytics
  • Improve our service and user experience
  • Send important account-related notifications

3. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures:

  • All data is transmitted over secure SSL protocols
  • Passwords are encrypted using bcrypt hashing
  • Database access is restricted and monitored
  • Regular security audits and updates

4. Data Sharing

We never sell or share your personal data with third parties. Your information is only used to provide and improve our habit tracking service.

5. Your Rights

You have complete control over your data:

  • View and update your information anytime
  • Delete your account and all associated data
  • Export your habit data
  • Opt-out of non-essential data collection

6. Children's Privacy

HabitLoop does not knowingly collect data from children under 18. If you believe we have collected data from a child, please contact us immediately.

7. Policy Updates

We may update this privacy policy occasionally. Significant changes will be communicated through the app or email.

8. Contact Us

For any privacy concerns or data requests:
